meta.title: Cooper Dismedic — Pharmaceutical Distribution in Morocco
meta.description: A member of the Cooper Pharma group, Cooper Dismedic provides pharmaceutical and parapharmaceutical distribution to pharmacies and healthcare facilities across Morocco.

hero.subtitle: Cooper Dismedic, a member of the Cooper Pharma group, distributes medicines, medical devices and parapharmaceutical products with rigor and traceability across Morocco.

features.label: Why Cooper Dismedic
features.f1Desc: Since 1995, Cooper Dismedic has distributed pharmaceuticals, medical devices and parapharmaceutical products with unwavering reliability. The Cooper Pharma group has over 90 years of pharmaceutical history.
features.f2Desc: Original and generic drugs, medical devices, parapharmacy and dietary supplements — a complete catalogue serving all your pharmacy needs.
features.f3Desc: Certified BPF/GMP Morocco, ANSM (France), Saudi FDA and ISO 9001. Every product, every delivery, every procedure meets the highest regulatory standards.

about.label: Our Story
about.title: Part of Cooper Pharma, Morocco's leading pharmaceutical group
about.p1: Founded in 1995, Cooper Dismedic is part of the Cooper Pharma group's distribution network, a major player in the Moroccan pharmaceutical industry since 1933. Our mission: ensuring medication accessibility for all.
about.p2: Based in Casablanca, Cooper Dismedic distributes pharmaceutical, parapharmaceutical, cosmetic, medical device and dietary supplement products to pharmacies and healthcare facilities. The Cooper Pharma group has over 1,200 employees and 9 distribution companies across the kingdom.

services.label: Our Services
services.title: Pharmaceutical Distribution & Logistics
services.subtitle: From product reception to pharmacy delivery, we ensure quality, traceability and regulatory compliance at every step.
services.s1Desc: GMP-compliant warehouses with temperature control and full batch traceability.
services.s2Desc: Ordering service available every day from 8:30 AM to 8:00 PM for responsive distribution.
services.s3Desc: Temperature monitoring to preserve the integrity of sensitive pharmaceutical products.
services.s4Desc: Computerized batch tracking system from supplier to pharmacy.
services.s5Desc: Strict adherence to national distribution standards under our responsible pharmacist's supervision.
services.s6Desc: Rigorous processing of returns and credit notes with partner pharmacies and laboratories.

commitments.label: Our Commitments
commitments.title: Quality and health at the heart of our mission
commitments.subtitle: As a member of the Cooper Pharma group, we share the same CSR commitments for environment, health and education.
commitments.envDesc: Waste reduction, eco-designed packaging and green logistics for a sustainable future.
commitments.healthDesc: Access to care, prevention and partnerships with healthcare professionals across Morocco.
commitments.eduDesc: Preschool support, awareness and continuing education for healthcare professionals.

team.label: Our Team
team.title: Our Human Capital
team.subtitle: A dedicated team serving pharmacies and healthcare facilities. Each team member contributes to the quality and responsiveness of our service.
team.v1Desc: Strict adherence to pharmaceutical procedures and standards
team.v2Desc: Orders processed every day from 8:30 AM to 8:00 PM
